concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one premium high fidelity design presentation board, wide landscape 16:10 composition, for the existing Chinese PICO headset app "L's VR Player". This is concept A, called "A · 深色影院". Design an implementable Unity world-space media interface with controller-ray input, NOT a website or a sci-fi hologram.
Art direction: quiet, contemporary private cinema. Matte ink-blue surfaces #10161D, panels #1A242E, bright restrained seafoam accent #62D5C7, primary text #F2F6F7, legible secondary text #B0BAC6. Broad gentle 24px corners on windows, smaller 12px corners on controls. No neon, no decorative glow, no gradients on buttons, no tiny typography, no real-time glass blur. Use confident Chinese sans-serif typography and refined consistent outline icons. Buttons have ample space and thick readable shapes.
Board composition: a very small plain title at top left "A · 深色影院", then a large front-on media browser filling the top approximately 62% of board, a compact playback control module bottom left and a projection-setting module bottom right. All modules fully visible with wide gutters, no perspective warping, enough scale that UI labels remain readable. The small lower modules represent alternative UI states, NOT three windows open together. Dark calm studio backdrop, subtle visual depth only.
Main media browser: top brand at upper right "L's VR Player", five stable main tabs "文件", "投影", "字幕", "设置", "信息", with 文件 active by a seafoam underline. Within file page a quiet left source sidebar with icon+text entries "本地", "SMB", "Emby", "收藏", "最近", Emby active with soft mint selection. Main top breadcrumb "Emby / 电影", separate back arrow and physical-parent arrow, a large search field "搜索影片", view selector "海报" and more button. Content shows a horizontal "继续播放" card with fictional night-ocean scene and movie "静海" and seafoam button "继续播放", followed by a "影片" row of 5 large 2:3 original poster artworks, night ocean, mountain, astronaut, forest, city, titles "静海", "山间", "远航", "林深", "夜行". Posters show understated progress bars and large readable titles below. Artwork is generic original illustrative art, not copyrighted film posters. All artwork originates from hypothetical Emby results; no recommendations or cloud services. Current mini transport footer has time "32:18 / 1:48:06", a clear seek rail and play/pause affordance.
Bottom-left quick playback state: title "快捷播放"; quiet dark wide rounded bar with file title "静海", separate seek rail with "32:18" and "1:48:06", a large central pause button, previous/next, subtitles, volume, format, speed icons with Chinese labels "字幕", "音量", "模式", "1.0×". Below or at edge a clearly labeled action "停止并返回", distinct from simply hiding UI.
Bottom-right projection state: title "投影"; two DISTINCT labeled groups "画面投影" containing "平面", "VR180", "VR360", with VR180 selected, and "立体布局" containing "2D", "左右", "上下", with 左右 selected. Do not conflate SBS with VR180. Show "全景缩放" slider "1.0×", plus "重置缩放", and secondary compact options "高级". Legible active selection uses fill plus checkmark, not just color.
Constraints: maintain Chinese UI, large controller targets, realistic clean alignments, semantic hierarchy, no headset/controller illustration, no human figure, no browser chrome, no footer disclaimers, no tiny explanatory paragraphs, no fake performance stats, no watermark. Render polished actual UI surfaces rather than a wireframe.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one high fidelity design presentation board, wide landscape 16:10 composition, for the Chinese PICO VR media app "L's VR Player". Concept B: "B · 雾面空间". This is a Unity world-space UI operated by handheld controller rays. The visual direction must be unmistakably LIGHT, spacious and soft, with restrained spatial material, NOT a website.
Palette: cool fog-grey environment #D7DFE4, softly opaque porcelain-grey panel #F0F4F5, charcoal-blue text #1C2C3A, readable slate secondary #50616E, refined cobalt-blue selection #315CCA and white text on blue buttons. Rounded outer corners 32px, broad generous whitespace, soft subtle edges and minimal shadow, surfaces clearly legible and mostly opaque. No cream/terracotta, no rainbow gradients, no aggressive liquid glass, no translucent text, no neon. Use Chinese sans-serif type with generous weight, refined consistent outline icon system.
Board composition: small title "B · 雾面空间" at top left; a large front-on browser across upper approximately 62% of board; below, left a large compact playback controller and right a projection-setting panel. All three examples fully visible, large readable labels, no perspective distortion. These are three alternative screen states, not simultaneous floating windows.
Distinct main layout: one quiet narrow vertical PRIMARY navigation rail with icon+text labels "文件", "投影", "字幕", "设置", "信息", 文件 active with rounded cobalt selection. Brand "L's VR Player" above content. Source selector inside file page at top as an airy pill segment "本地", "SMB", "Emby", "收藏", "最近", Emby selected. Content title "电影" plus breadcrumb "Emby / 电影", generous search box "搜索影片", separate back and physical-parent icons, view menu "海报". A beautifully clean row for "继续播放": original mountain-and-lake artwork left, title "静海", progress "32:18 / 1:48:06", blue button "继续播放" right. Underneath 4 or 5 comfortably spaced large original 2:3 art posters with clearly readable titles "静海", "山间", "远航", "林深", "夜行". Original scenes depict ocean, misty mountain, space, trees, city. No real film brands or copyrighted posters. Preserve picture aspect ratios. Thin progress bars under selected posters, no unnecessary card borders.
Bottom-left "快捷播放": a pill-shaped porcelain-grey playback bar, separate thin blue seek line, readable title "静海", times "32:18" and "1:48:06", one blue circular central pause control surrounded by previous and next. Remaining icon+text controls "字幕", "音量", "模式", "1.0×". Distinct small action "停止并返回", do not imply X only hides the panel. Large spaced raycast targets, a soft blue focus outline around one control.
Bottom-right "投影": airy grey panel, two separate stacked labeled segmented controls: "画面投影" with "平面", "VR180", "VR360", VR180 selected, and "立体布局" with "2D", "左右", "上下", 左右 selected. Blue selection and clear checkmark. "全景缩放" with a readable horizontal slider "1.0×", "重置缩放", "高级". Do not conflate stereo layout with projection.
Constraints: contemporary refined material UI, controlled white area suitable for a headset, stable alignment and physical controller input, no eye-tracking imagery, no hand-gesture-only operation, no user identities or network addresses, no decorative room render, no browser chrome, no headset or people, no watermark, no tiny body text. Full product mockup quality, not a wireframe.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one professional high fidelity UI design board in a wide landscape 16:10 composition for Chinese PICO VR app "L's VR Player". This is concept C, title "C · 专业控制台". Unity world-space panels with controller-ray input. The visual identity is contemporary precise audio/video equipment: dark warm mineral-grey, restrained amber selection, generous legible controls, quiet craftsmanship. Not a website, not a futuristic cockpit.
Palette: base #191918, raised surface #262723, row surface #30312D, readable off-white #F5F0E7, secondary #BEBCAF, amber #E8B56A. Use flat matte surfaces, slightly squared corners (outer 16px, buttons 8px), clear alignment, excellent typography, moderate information density. No cyan or purple, no neon, no tiny monospace debugging numbers, no wood texture, no bevel skeuomorphism, no matrix HUD.
Board layout: small title "C · 专业控制台" top left. Large front-on media browser fills upper approximately 62%. Two supplementary states along bottom: a labeled quick playback controller left, a clearly grouped projection panel right. All fully visible and large enough to read. They are alternative states, not three panels operating simultaneously.
Main browser: brand "L's VR Player" upper right, horizontal primary tabs "文件", "投影", "字幕", "设置", "信息", 文件 active amber underline. Within file page left source rail "本地", "SMB", "Emby", "收藏", "最近", Emby selected. Header breadcrumb "Emby / 电影", search "搜索影片", list view menu "列表", sort "名称", separate back icon and physical-parent icon. Main content intentionally uses EXISTING Emby LIST view instead of a poster grid: 5 broad spacious horizontal rows, each with a beautiful original landscape movie thumbnail in its original 16:9 ratio at left, movie name in large readable Chinese, restrained metadata, and labelled progress "播放进度" with slim amber progress rail. Column headings "影片", "播放进度", "时长". Row titles "静海", "山间", "远航", "林深", "夜行", first row active with amber indicator and visible "继续播放" button. Original thumbnails depict ocean at dusk, mountain pass, space station, forest, urban night. No copyrighted films. Footer provides stable current playback strip "静海", pause control and timeline "32:18 / 1:48:06", plus an understated "投影" entry. Do not show engineering telemetry or private file paths.
Bottom-left "快捷播放": a rectangular rounded precise transport bar with a separated amber progress rail and times. Central larger amber pause button, readable icon+text buttons "字幕", "音量", previous, next, "模式", "1.0×". There is a distinct correctly labeled "停止并返回" action. Emphasize predictable buttons over hidden hover-only interactions.
Bottom-right "投影": precise grouped panel. Separate first group "画面投影" with selectable "平面", "VR180", "VR360", second group "立体布局" with "2D", "左右", "上下". Select VR180 and 左右 with amber fill and checkmarks independently. Third group "全景缩放" slider "1.0×", action "重置缩放", and "高级" entry. Never equate SBS with VR180.
Constraints: warm neutral professional identity, high readability in VR, large raycast hit areas and clear selected/pressed semantics, original demo artworks, no web chrome, no people or headset, no holographs, no gimmicky dials, no excessive thin borders, no tiny caption paragraphs, no fake metrics, no watermark. Polished practical product UI suitable for later Unity implementation.
